english:
Picking up an Orb of Power with a charged Super Ability grants a stack of 'Feast of Light'. Maximum of 6 stacks. Swapping to another Exotic Class Item with Spirit of the Star-Eater preserves your stacks.

Casting your Super at 1|2|3|4|5|6 stacks consumes all stacks and grants 18.2%|36.4%|54.6%|59.7%|64.8%|70% increased Super damage for 14 seconds.

Some Supers receive a smaller bonus:
• <void Nova Bomb />, <arc Thundercrash />, and <void Twilight Arsenal /> receive up to 50% increased Super damage.
• <strand Needlestorm /> receives up to 35% increased Super damage.

<solar Song of Flame /> does not receive increased <solar Solar /> Effect Damage.

source.text:
Picking up an Orb of Power while Super is charged grants a stack of Feast of Light, up to a maximum of x6 stacks.
Swapping to another Exotic Class Item with Star-Eaters will maintain the current Feast of Light stacks.

On Super Cast:
Consumes all Feast of Light stacks, increasing Super Damage for 14 seconds.
18.2% | 36.4% | 54.6% | 59.7% | 64.8% | 70% increased Super Damage.

Reduced effectiveness with certain Super Abilities.
Song of Flame does not receive increased Solar Effect Damage.
Nova Bomb, Thundercrash, and Twilight Arsenal receive up to 50% Increased Super Damage.
Needlestorm receives up to 35% Increased Super Damage.
